title: Scripture and Spiritual Warfare
definition: Scripture and Spiritual Warfare means God’s Word equips believers to stand against deception, temptation, accusation, and evil in the strength of Christ.
summary: Scripture and Spiritual Warfare means God’s Word equips believers to stand against deception, temptation, accusation, and evil in the strength of Christ.
christFocus: Jesus defeated Satan’s temptations with Scripture and has triumphed over every evil power through His cross and resurrection.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Spiritual warfare is real, but Scripture keeps believers from fear, obsession, and speculation. The Bible teaches believers to stand in Christ, resist deception, reject temptation, pray, and hold fast to truth.

The Word of God is called the sword of the Spirit. Scripture exposes lies, answers temptation, strengthens faith, and reminds believers that Christ has already won the decisive victory.

The focus of spiritual warfare is not fascination with darkness. The focus is faithfulness to Jesus. Believers stand not by their own strength, but by the armor God provides and the power of the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Some people ignore spiritual opposition, while others become consumed by fear of it. Scripture gives a steady path: be watchful, resist evil, rely on Christ, and do not give darkness more attention than the Savior deserves.

This doctrine especially helps those battling addiction, accusation, or fear. The enemy lies, but Scripture speaks truth over those who belong to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Stand on God’s Word when tempted, accused, or afraid. Pray, resist the devil, reject lies with Scripture, seek support from faithful believers, and remember that your victory rests in Christ, not in your own strength.
